title: Parents or a class.
Reopening for the academic year 2026–27
body: Classes resume on Monday 1 June 2026. Students are to report in full uniform by 8:45 a.m.

title: Quarterly examination timetable
body: The quarterly examinations begin on Monday 3 August 2026. The detailed timetable is on the notice board outside the office.

title: Scholarship applications — last date
body: Applications for the Post-Matric and BC/MBC scholarships close on 12 September 2026. Parents of Std IX–XII students should collect the form from the office.

title: Attendance below 75%
body: Std X and Std XII students whose attendance is below 75% will not be permitted to sit the public examination. Class teachers are to contact the guardians concerned this week.

title: Independence Day photographs
body: Photographs from the 15 August celebration are available in the office. Parents may collect prints during working hours.
